messages:
Maya (docs): I opened a tiny PR adding a concrete audit-export example + notes about redaction/pseudonymization. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512
Owen (eng): Looking. Do we want JSONL as the canonical sample or show CSV first?
Maya (docs): JSONL primary, CSV mapping table included. Aim is a minimal, clearly non-sensitive example that matches runtime fields.
Priya (legal): Please ensure no raw emails, IPs, or unhashed IDs. Use placeholders like \"<redacted>\" or a hashed token. Also prefer \"pseudonymized or redacted\" over \"anonymized\" unless irreversible.
Tariq (platform): Suggest using \"hashed_actor_id\" in the examples and add \"actor_type\" (user/service). Also include an optional \"kms_key_id\" example to surface optional fields.
Maya (docs): Current snippet in PR:
```json
{"__metadata":{"export_time":"2025-02-03T18:00:00Z","requested_by":"hashed:3c6e0b8a9c15224a"},"timestamp":"2025-02-03T17:59:50Z","hashed_actor_id":"sha256:8f14e45fceea167a","actor_type":"service","event_type":"audit.log.write","ip":"<redacted>","kms_key_id":"optional:kms-7a2f","details":{"sdk":"go","action":"WriteLog"}}
```
Priya (legal): That looks compliant. Two tiny copy tweaks: 1) change any instance of \"PII removed\" to \"pseudonymized or redacted\"; 2) add a caption: \"Fields containing sensitive identifiers are redacted or pseudonymized in examples.\"
Owen (eng): I'll validate the field names with the runtime and run the CSV mapping render locally. If any mismatch I’ll push a small schema note to the PR.
docs-linter: lint warning - sample-json-literal should be fenced with ```json (found) - OK.
Maya (docs): Thanks all. I requested formal legal ACK on the PR and will merge once CI + lint pass and we have the ACK. :thumbsup:
